import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    
    static class Modular {
        int value;
        
        Modular(long v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            value = (int)v;
        }
        
        Modular(int v) {
            value = v % MOD;
            if (value < 0) value += MOD;
        }
        
        Modular() {
            value = 0;
        }
        
        static int modInverse(int a, int m) {
            int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                g %= r;
                int temp = g; g = r; r = temp;
                x -= q * y;
                temp = x; x = y; y = temp;
            }
            return x < 0 ? x + m : x;
        }
        
        static int modInverse(int a) {
            return modInverse(a, MOD);
        }
        
        int intValue() {
            return value;
        }
        
        Modular add(Modular other) {
            value += other.value;
            if (value >= MOD) value -= MOD;
            return this;
        }
        
        Modular sub(Modular other) {
            value -= other.value;
            if (value < 0) value += MOD;
            return this;
        }
        
        static long fastMod(long x) {
            return x % MOD;
        }
        
        Modular mul(Modular other) {
            value = (int)fastMod((long)value * other.value);
            return this;
        }
        
        Modular div(Modular other) {
            return mul(other.modInverseObj());
        }
        
        Modular addAssign(Modular other) {
            return add(other);
        }
        
        Modular subAssign(Modular other) {
            return sub(other);
        }
        
        Modular mulAssign(Modular other) {
            return mul(other);
        }
        
        Modular divAssign(Modular other) {
            return div(other);
        }
        
        Modular modInverseObj() {
            return new Modular(modInverse(value));
        }
        
        Modular pow(long exp) {
            if (exp < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exponent must be non-negative");
            Modular base = new Modular(this.value);
            Modular res = new Modular(1);
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                    res.mul(base);
                }
                base.mul(base);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
        
        Modular inc() {
            value = (value == MOD - 1) ? 0 : value + 1;
            return this;
        }
        
        Modular dec() {
            value = (value == 0) ? MOD - 1 : value - 1;
            return this;
        }
        
        Modular neg() {
            return value != 0 ? new Modular(MOD - value) : new Modular(0);
        }
        
        boolean equals(Modular other) {
            return value == other.value;
        }
        
        boolean notEquals(Modular other) {
            return value != other.value;
        }
    }
    
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 7;
    static int size;
    static Modular[][] chance = new Modular[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        size = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                chance[i][j] = new Modular(p).div(new Modular(100));
            }
        }
        
        List<List<Integer>> masksByCardinality = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_SIZE; ++i) {
            masksByCardinality.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        
        int[] positionMap = new int[1 << size];
        Arrays.fill(positionMap, -1);
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << size); ++mask) {
            int cardinality = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            positionMap[mask] = masksByCardinality.get(cardinality).size();
            masksByCardinality.get(cardinality).add(mask);
        }
        
        Map<Long, Modular> stateMap = new HashMap<>();
        stateMap.put(1L << positionMap[0], new Modular(1));
        
        for (int iteration = 0; iteration < size; ++iteration) {
            Map<Long, Modular> nextStateMap = new HashMap<>();
            
            for (int current = 0; current < (1 << size); ++current) {
                Modular product = new Modular(1);
                for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j) {
                    if (((current >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                        product = product.mul(chance[iteration][j]);
                    } else {
                        Modular one = new Modular(1);
                        Modular chanceVal = chance[iteration][j];
                        Modular diff = new Modular(one.value - chanceVal.value);
                        if (diff.value < 0) diff.value += MOD;
                        product = product.mul(diff);
                    }
                }
                
                for (Map.Entry<Long, Modular> entry : stateMap.entrySet()) {
                    long currentState = entry.getKey();
                    Modular prob = entry.getValue();
                    
                    long nextState = 0;
                    
                    for (int mask : masksByCardinality.get(iteration)) {
                        if (((currentState >> positionMap[mask]) & 1) == 1) {
                            for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
                                if ((((current >> i) & 1) == 1) && (((mask >> i) & 1) == 0)) {
                                    nextState |= 1L << positionMap[mask | (1 << i)];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    
                    Modular newProb = prob.mul(product);
                    nextStateMap.put(nextState, nextStateMap.getOrDefault(nextState, new Modular(0)).addAssign(newProb));
                }
            }
            
            stateMap = nextStateMap;
        }
        
        Modular finalAnswer = new Modular(0);
        long fullSet = (1L << size) - 1;
        
        for (Map.Entry<Long, Modular> entry : stateMap.entrySet()) {
            if (((entry.getKey() >> positionMap[(int)fullSet]) & 1) == 1) {
                finalAnswer = finalAnswer.addAssign(entry.getValue());
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(finalAnswer.intValue());
    }
}
